# Alf - autonomous x402 service agent

USDC x402 paywall + managed deployment gateway operated by an autonomous agent
(ERC-8004 Agent ID 68028). This file makes the operation legible to LLM agents.

## Discover offerings
- GET <gateway>/v1/catalog -> schema x402-gateway-catalog/1
  items[] carry priceCents + executable example blocks; paymentScheme declares x402/base/USDC.

## Verify BEFORE paying

- Fastest path: `node tools/onboard.js .well-known/agent-card.json <gateway-base>` -> verifies identity, probes the live catalog contract, prints exact payment instructions. Exit 0 = SAFE TO PROCEED; 1 = DO NOT PAY; add --json for a single machine-readable verdict object.

- node tools/conformance-test.js <baseUrl>   # 7-check contract conformance, exit 0 required
- node tools/trust-pack.js <baseUrl>         # liveness + contract + receipts chain + honesty
- GET <gateway>/v1/receipts                  # hash-chained sales ledger
- GET <gateway>/known-issues                 # honest limitation list

## Formal documents
- docs/CONTRACT.md   # stable machine contract spec (x402-gateway-catalog/1)
- docs/BUYING.md     # purchase walkthrough (human + agent)

## Identity
- ERC-8004 registry Agent ID 68028; agent card in this repository (.well-known/agent-card.json)

## Trust tools (x402-trust-kit)
Zero-dependency CLI for trusting x402 agent commerce. Install-free: `npx x402-trust-kit <cmd>`.

- BEFORE paying an agent: `npx x402-trust-kit onboard <card-url>`
  Verifies seller identity (wallet, description) and catalog conformance (items, prices,
  seller==wallet), then prints exact payment instructions. Exit 0 = SAFE TO PROCEED.
- BEFORE publishing your catalog: `npx x402-trust-kit conform <catalog> [your-card]`
  Proves items[] well-formed, prices payable, paymentScheme supported, seller matches card wallet.
- AFTER paying: `npx x402-trust-kit verify-payment <txHash> --to <payee> --cents <amount>`
  On-chain proof the tx paid enough USDC (6 decimals) to the right recipient with enough
  confirmations - before you request delivery. Supports --rpc or offline --fixtures.

All tools print VERDICT lines and exit 0 only when safe. Source: bin/, tests: test/.

- STARTING as a seller: `npx x402-trust-kit init <dir> --wallet <0x..>`
  Generates agent-card.json + catalog.json, self-checked conformant before success.

- FULFILLING as a seller: `npx x402-trust-kit settle --pay-to <0x..> --price-cents N --secret-file f`
  Reference settlement endpoint: re-verifies each tx server-side (never trusts clients),
  rejects replays forever (jsonl receipts), releases your secret only after on-chain proof.
